sky cinema premiere.title: The End of Oak Street

sky cinema premiere.title: Mutiny
sky cinema premiere.desc: Framed for the murder of his billionaire boss, a vengeful man uncovers an international conspiracy as he battles a gang of thugs aboard a cargo ship.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious 7
sky cinema action.desc: After defeating international terrorist Owen Shaw, Dominic Toretto, Brian O'Conner and the rest of the crew have separated to return to more normal lives. However, Deckard Shaw, Owen's older brother, is thirsty for revenge. A slick government agent offers to help Dom and company take care of Shaw in exchange for their help in rescuing a kidnapped computer hacker who has developed a powerful surveillance program.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious 8
sky cinema action.desc: The globetrotting crew faces an unexpected challenge when a mysterious woman named Cipher forces Dom to betray them all. Now, they must unite to bring home the man who made them a family and stop her from unleashing chaos on a grand scale.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
sky cinema action.desc: Brixton Lorr is a cybernetically enhanced soldier who possesses superhuman strength, a brilliant mind and a lethal pathogen that could wipe out half of the world's population. It's now up to hulking lawman Luke Hobbs and lawless operative Deckard Shaw to put aside their past differences and work together to prevent the seemingly indestructible Lorr from destroying humanity.

sky cinema family.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
sky cinema family.desc: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. even for the world's most powerful vampire.

sky cinema family.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Movie
sky cinema family.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for, ending up in the Big City.

sky cinema family.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
sky cinema family.desc: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Phoenician Scheme
sky cinema comedy.desc: Wealthy businessman, Zsa-zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Naked Gun
sky cinema comedy.desc: Following in the footsteps of his bumbling father, Detective Frank Drebin Jr. must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from shutting down.

sky cinema comedy.title: Shaun of the Dead
sky cinema comedy.desc: Shaun's humdrum existence takes a turn for the interesting when the undead take over London. Leaping into action, Shaun gathers his loved ones in the safest place he knows. Shaun, his mum and her boyfriend, his girlfriend, Liz, and his flatmates Ed and Pete fight off a fate worse than death from the local pub.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Critters
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Hilarity and horror ensue when toothy, carnivorous aliens escape from their space prison, pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. When they reach the Kansas farmhouse of an all-American family, the humans do everything they can to fend off the critters, but they cannot free themselves of the ferocious outsiders.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Mickey 17
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Anaconda
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The film crew for a nature documentary on a legendary tribe of the area is hijacked by Sarone, a madman intent on capturing the biggest snake in the Amazon, but since reptiles don't grow to 40 feet without eating, who's hunting whom?

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Evolution
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A science professor and his cohorts battle a slew of rapidly growing alien organisms that threaten to overrun the Earth.

sky cinema thriller.title: Detroit
sky cinema thriller.desc: As rioting and civil unrest rocks Detroit during the summer of 1967, several policemen begin interrogating guests at the Algiers Motel. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

sky cinema thriller.title: Black Bag
sky cinema thriller.desc: When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
sky cinema thriller.desc: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

sky cinema thriller.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema thriller.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema greats.title: The Towering Inferno
sky cinema greats.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

sky cinema greats.title: The Hunt for Red October
sky cinema greats.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws
sky cinema greats.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws 2
sky cinema greats.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

sky cinema drama.title: Escape to Victory
sky cinema drama.desc: When ex-German international and camp commandant Van Steiner suggests a match between the POWs and the Germans, it swiftly escalates into a propaganda exercise.

sky cinema drama.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
sky cinema drama.desc: A single father and his young son endure many hardships as the father struggles to provide a better future for both of them.

sky cinema drama.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
sky cinema drama.desc: Through a surprising twist of fate, single strangers Sarah and David get to relive important moments from their respective pasts, illuminating how they got to where they are in the present.

sky cinema drama.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
sky cinema drama.desc: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now manages. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a fellow youngster on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.
